description: ZZZS, Slovenia's public health insurer, publishes a data portal with the bulk data it holds on the delivery of insured health care. It includes named lists of active doctors in general practice, children's and school dispensaries, gynaecology and dentistry, the planned and delivered programme of services for each health activity, data on access to services, the planned number of care teams at each provider, treatments by health worker, medicine use, sickness absence by region and activity, and the insurer's finances. A searchable list of all contracted providers by type is also available. Coverage is national, down to individual providers. The data are free and available on the ZZZS site as bulk data to view and download page by page; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: the portal is a set of separate pages in Slovenian, not one database, some lists are only searchable, and hospital capacity is described through programmes, not beds. Simulation uses: mapping primary care capacity and patient lists by municipality, testing the effect of losing a provider on access, and planning workforce needs. Related records: GISCO healthcare services (data-gisco-healthcare-services-europe) map Slovenian hospitals, and the WHO health infrastructure indicators (data-who-gho-health-infrastructure-indicators) give comparisons.
